AnonymizeText.Description: Anonymizes personal and sensitive information in text.
AnonymizeText.Name: text-anonymizer
AnonymizeText.Instructions: Analyze the text for personally identifiable information (PII). Replace person names with [PERSON], email addresses with [EMAIL], phone numbers with [PHONE], national identification numbers with [NATIONAL_ID], postal addresses with [ADDRESS], dates of birth with [DATE_OF_BIRTH], bank account numbers with [BANK_ACCOUNT], and other sensitive personal data with an appropriate placeholder. Preserve all other text exactly as written. Do not summarize, rephrase, add, remove, or explain anything. Return only the anonymized text. If no PII is found, return the original text unchanged.

AssessTextTrustworthiness.Description: Assesses how well text supports its claims and highlights unsupported or uncertain statements.
AssessTextTrustworthiness.Name: text-trustworthiness-assessor
AssessTextTrustworthiness.Instructions: Analyze the text for personally identifiable information (PII). Detect person names, email addresses, phone numbers, national identification numbers, postal addresses, dates of birth, bank account numbers, and other sensitive personal data. Return only valid JSON with the fields riskLevel (Low, Medium, High), containsPii (true/false), detectedEntities (array with type and value), and explanation. If no PII is found, return containsPii=false and an empty detectedEntities array. Be precise, neutral, and do not invent information.
